cases.name: Michelle Ann Whalen Mockbee
cases.about: Michelle was a Logistics Support Representative for Thermo Fisher Scientific. She worked as an administrative assistant who handled TFS’s payroll and timesheets.
cases.narrative: She also suffered deep cuts. Her body was found in the mezzanine area of Thermo Fisher Scientific (“TFS”), a large medical supply facility where she worked. She suffered deep cuts and was beaten, hands and feet bound, with a plastic restaurant take-out bag over her head.
